tom_dick_and_harry_2.notes: No verified theatrical trailer found. The film (also marketed as 'Tom Dick and Harry Returns') was widely reported as canned/shelved due to production issues; per Deepak Tijori's later interviews it never received a theatrical release. Closest YouTube assets are press-event clips (e.g. r2r6sRFYjMM, gqphMqByqp8 — a 2021 'Tom Dick and Harry Return' clip), none of which are confirmable as an official theatrical trailer.
